    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

            while c < w and row[c] != bg:
                c += 1

                runs.append((c - start, r, start, row[start:c]))
    _, _, _, motif = max(runs)
    # Select the singleton color not used by the motif as the marker.
    motif_colors = set(motif)
